contexts.text: If from a string even to a latchet of a shoe () = all things which were unclean natural and corporeal. Explained... By the string of a shoe is signified what is false; and by the latchet of a shoe, what is evil; and this the lowest of all, because it is in the diminutive.
This was meant by John the Baptist, when he said, There cometh One stronger than I; the latchet of Whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose.
